# Vendored wtransport fork

Verbatim `git archive` of https://github.com/vmeansdev/wtransport at
`c1888a890525ad79b58a3f1970afcfdec60d46f7` (the rev pinned in the root
Cargo.toml), limited to the workspace manifest, licenses and the two crates.
Vendored so reviewed local driver changes can be built from this repository
without publishing a new fork revision. Wired in via the root
`[patch."https://github.com/vmeansdev/wtransport"]`.
